description: How traditional assets (Treasury bills, money-market funds, private credit, real estate) are represented as on-chain tokens, who holds the underlying asset, where '24/7 instant liquidity' claims hold and where they fall short, and what U.S. regulators had said as of early 2026. Based on SEC primary sources and rwa.xyz market data as of September 2026. Full content with an active plugin subscription; otherwise lesson titles and key takeaways only.
